text.tspan: how does it look in different
how it looks on colored bg's

colours that we don't see a lot out there and that we have on the main brand
the indigo made it look like stripe,
so I wanted to avoid it.
Also teal connects it with main brand,

so I wanted to avoid it. Also teal connects it with main brand, diethos
